newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia's Bjelovarska Banka says to double capital.
newsitem.headline: Croatia's Bjelovarska Banka says to double capital.

text.p: Croatia's Bjelovarska Banka said on Tuesday it planned to issue some 22,000 new shares at 4,000 kuna each to double its capital.
"We expect the securities commission to approve the issue within ninety days," Marija Vidakovic, member of the bank's board told Reuters.
She also confirmed two Austrian banks -- GiroCredit and Bank Styria -- were interested in purchasing half of the new issue each.
Bjelovarska's shares closed 17 percent lower at 4,150 kuna last Friday on an over-the-counter market in Varazdin. -- Metka Jelenc, Zagreb Newsroom, 385 1 4557075
